idea-plugin.name: Claude Chat
idea-plugin.description:
I wanted a dedicated GUI for my Claude Code CLI inside JetBrains IDEs and could not find one that met my needs, so I built Claude Chat.

Chat in a standalone IDE tool window using your locally installed, authenticated Claude Code CLI.

Uses the account already signed in with the CLI. Includes model and effort controls, active-editor context, session continuity, and an explicit edit mode.

Requires Claude Code CLI. This independent plugin is not affiliated with Anthropic or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Renamed the plugin to Claude Chat and updated its description to explain why it was built.
